name: animated-sidebar
title: Animated Sidebar
description: A collapsible side navigation with groups, badges and sub-menus.

props.name: theme
props.label: Theme
props.description: Colour palette, tooltips included. With Highlight color set to Primary, the active item takes its primary colour.

props.name: mode
props.label: Mode
props.description: Light or dark version of the palette. Starts dark.

props.name: resizable
props.label: Drag edge to resize
props.description: Lets you drag the sidebar's edge to change its width.

props.name: itemRounded
props.label: Item roundness
props.description: Corner radius of the items and their highlight.

props.name: slideHighlight
props.label: Slide highlight
props.description: The active highlight slides to the newly chosen item instead of jumping.

props.name: activeIndicator
props.label: Active indicator
props.description: Extra mark on the active item.

props.name: rollingText
props.label: Rolling text
props.description: Item labels roll to a second copy on hover.

props.name: elasticTooltips
props.label: Elastic tooltips
props.description: Tooltips spring out when the sidebar is collapsed to icons.

props.name: rollingNumbers
props.label: Rolling numbers
props.description: Badge counts roll to the new number and pop.

props.name: showTeamSwitcher
props.label: Show team switcher
props.description: Shows a team menu at the top of the sidebar.

props.name: spinToggle
props.label: Spin toggle
props.description: The collapse button spins half a turn on hover.

props.name: showBreadcrumb
props.label: Show breadcrumb
props.description: Shows a breadcrumb and search in the page header.

props.name: scaleContent
props.label: Scale content
props.description: Page content scales and fades slightly when you switch pages.
